message: Beta field-validation candidate. Use only for a legitimate due PPE inspection. Any item marked VERIFY IN VECTOR must be independently confirmed in Vector history before relying on the run as validated.
releaseNotes: rc15 hardens post-submit completion verification and recovery, preserves fail-closed persistence before every irreversible Submit, adds auditable run-summary diagnostics, and adds the persistent Rebel-starbird minimize UI. Scope is frozen for field validation.
